map.狗狗猫咪年龄转换为人类等效年龄（仅近似参考）。: Convert a dog's or cat's age to an equivalent human age (approximate reference only).
map.犬龄换算人类年龄：前 2 年每年折约 12 至 15 岁（1 岁约 15 岁、2: Dog age to human age: the first 2 years count about 12 to 15 human years each (1 yr ≈ 15, 2 yr ≈ 24), then by body size add 4 to 7 human years per year (small 4, medium 5, large 6, extra-large 7); cat age: the first 2 years count as 15 and 9 respectively, then add 4 human years per year; a human-equivalent age above 7 is late adulthood and above 10 is senior, when joint, oral and metabolic assessments should be strengthened.
map.犬种体型/猫龄类型: Dog body size / cat age type
map.把犬猫真实年龄折算成对等人类岁数，直观理解它的生命阶段与养护重点。: Convert a dog's or cat's real age into an equivalent human age to intuitively understand its life stage and care priorities.
map.按换算后的阶段（幼年/成年/老年）匹配饮食、疫苗、运动与体检频率。: Match diet, vaccination, exercise and check-up frequency to the converted stage (juvenile / adult / senior).
map.向领养人科普“小型犬更长寿、老年来得晚”等品种差异。: Educate adopters on breed differences such as 'small dogs live longer and age later'.
map.猫 3 岁 → 16+(3-2)×4 = 20 人类岁（成年）；小型犬 5 岁: Cat 3 yr → 16+(3-2)×4 = 20 human yr (adult); small dog 5 yr → 16×ln5+31 ≈ 56.75 → 57 human yr (adult); large dog 3 yr → 22×ln3+15+2 ≈ 41 human yr (already near senior). The tool also labels stages by <1 juvenile / <7 adult / ≥7 senior.
map.猫和狗的换算公式一样吗？: Are the cat and dog conversion formulas the same?
map.不一样。猫：<1岁×15、<2岁 24+(a-1)×2、≥2岁 16+(a-2): No. Cat: <1 yr ×15, <2 yr 24+(a-1)×2, ≥2 yr 16+(a-2)×4. Dog: ≤2 yr small/medium takes 12, large takes age×10.5; >2 yr small/medium by 16×ln(age)+31, large plus +2 (capped at 100 yr). Large dogs age faster.
map.换算结果能当医疗依据吗？: Can the conversion result be used as a medical basis?
map.仅作参考。公式给出近似对等人类年龄，帮助理解阶段；具体寿命与健康管理仍受遗传、营: Reference only. The formula gives an approximate equivalent human age to help understand the stage; actual lifespan and health management are still affected by genetics, nutrition and medical conditions; senior dogs and cats should have more frequent check-ups.
